release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.33 (Build 33) - Admin Panel Enhancements & Web Performance:
- Enhanced admin panel with scrollable TabBar and AppBar icons for better accessibility
- Added delete chat functionality for admins to delete individual chats and all messages
- Fixed media files counting to include all types (image, video, document, file, media)
- Fixed statistics display to use accurate API data instead of local arrays
- Improved web app performance by making initialization non-blocking
- Fixed web app freezing issues with timeout protection and background initialization
- Fixed admin health status display in System Health Monitoring
- Better responsive design for admin panel icons on all screen sizes
- Enhanced user experience with proper error handling and loading states
